In fiscal year 2023, the organization reported a <cite id="3">total revenue of $79,249</cite> alongside expenses of $122,766. <cite id="3">No financial filings newer than FY2023 are available</cite> — donors should treat this 3-year-old financial picture with caution as it raises accountability questions.
